stack_name: AWS Bedrock AgentCore + AgentCore Payments + Strands SDK
speaks_to: You are an agent on AWS Bedrock AgentCore with Payments enabled (Coinbase or Stripe/Privy wallet), or a Strands SDK agent in AgentCore Runtime doing A2A handoffs. Read this before a paid action group or sub-agent handoff.

wallet_capability.wallet_type: Coinbase wallet or Stripe/Privy wallet; credentials managed by AgentCore (agent never holds raw keys)

payment_call_mechanism.how_agent_calls_paid_tools: AgentCore payment manager intercepts 402 within your reasoning loop: request → 402 → manager authenticates the wallet → executes the stablecoin payment → attaches payment proof → returns content, with no interruption. Bazaar MCP server (10K+ endpoints) is exposed through AgentCore Gateway. Visa Intelligent Commerce adds tokenized card-rail with intent mandates.
payment_call_mechanism.payment_auth_method: AgentCore-managed wallet credential (token lifecycle managed by platform)
payment_call_mechanism.facilitator: Coinbase CDP x402 Facilitator (or Stripe for card rail)

expected_x402_flow: Agent calls a paid endpoint inside the reasoning loop
Server returns 402; AgentCore payment manager intercepts
Manager authenticates the managed wallet and executes the USDC payment
Payment proof attached; content delivered back to the agent in-loop
On A2A handoff, payment context (wallet token, session remaining, prior receipts) must serialize across the agent boundary

spend_policy_assumptions.note: Session spending limits are enforced per session; credential lifecycle is managed by AgentCore and the expiry surface is opaque to the agent (FM-05). Real card-rail (Visa) spend carries regulatory weight.

primary_failure_mode.description: A Strands A2A handoff passes payment context across an agent boundary via a malformed or truncated handoff schema. The sub-agent cannot authenticate, pay, or prove prior payment.
primary_failure_mode.payment_consequence: Cascade abort: the sub-agent stalls, may re-attempt a payment already made, or fails the whole task while the parent believes payment context was delivered.

observable_trigger_signals.signal: CloudWatch error-rate spike on a payment action group
AgentCore transaction traceability shows failed payment steps
Session spend-remaining reaches 0 before task completion
Sub-agent invocation fails with auth error on a payment tool after handoff
Bazaar gateway returns empty set for a niche endpoint not yet indexed

recommended_second_eyes_routes.when: an A2A handoff just failed or a sub-agent cannot pay/prove prior payment
recommended_second_eyes_routes.returns: distress_class handoff_failure + the deep pack to call next + stop/preserve/continue + escalate_if

recommended_second_eyes_routes.when: before a multi-agent run that will hand payment context across a boundary
recommended_second_eyes_routes.returns: wiring/handoff context check before you delegate

recommended_second_eyes_routes.when: session spend-remaining is approaching 0 or a payment step is being blocked
recommended_second_eyes_routes.returns: pay / do-not-pay decision support against remaining budget

recommended_second_eyes_routes.when: payment action group is erroring and you cannot tell auth from facilitator degradation
recommended_second_eyes_routes.returns: verify the claim before you act on a failed/ambiguous payment state

priority_rationale: Enterprise adoption velocity is high; the Visa integration means real card-rail spend; failure modes carry regulatory consequence (AWS-governed infrastructure plus real funds). FM-09 across the A2A boundary is the most catastrophic and least natively observable.
